investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Oakcrest Cloud (collaboration SaaS); Platform: AWS us-east-2 (zones us-east-2a/us-east-2b/us-east-2c); network range 10.154.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster oakcre-prod-useast (EKS); Database: postgres server docs-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-1df570616352b5b5e; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
